content.value: List the “rules of inference" for mathematical reasoning. Show that the hypothesis given below (15) lead to the conclusion: If I do not finish my program, then I will wake up refreshed.

“If you send me an email, then I will finish my program. If you do not send me an email, then I will go to sleep early. If I go to sleep early, I will wake up refreshed" (Use rules of inference only).

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
